stdout:
#!/bin/sh
# Nightly backup of node2:/srv/inventory/data to node1:/var/backups/inventory
# Retains only the 7 most recent dated archives.
set -eu

SRC_HOST=node2
SRC_DIR=/srv/inventory/data
DEST_DIR=/var/backups/inventory
RETAIN=7
DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
ARCHIVE="$DEST_DIR/inventory-data-$DATE.tar.gz"
LOG_TAG="backup-inventory"

mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

if ssh -o BatchMode=yes "antrieb@${SRC_HOST}" "tar czf - -C ${SRC_DIR} ." > "${ARCHIVE}.partial" 2>>/var/log/backup-inventory.log; then
    mv "${ARCHIVE}.partial" "$ARCHIVE"
    logger -t "$LOG_TAG" "backup succeeded: $ARCHIVE"
else
    rc=$?
    rm -f "${ARCHIVE}.partial"
    logger -t "$LOG_TAG" "backup FAILED (exit $rc) for $DATE"
    exit "$rc"
fi

# Retention: keep only the most recent $RETAIN archives.
ls -1t "$DEST_DIR"/inventory-data-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | tail -n "+$((RETAIN + 1))" | while IFS= read -r old; do
    rm -f "$old"
    logger -t "$LOG_TAG" "pruned old archive: $old"
done
